scope: EXT-D-0150 source routing and feature-test procedure repair; native browser acceptance remains outside this lane
cause: The WebMCP page message receiver had sender.tab.id, but dropped it before handleWebmcpCall built a ToolContext with assignedTabId null. Tab-aware handlers then resolved whichever tab was focused when they ran.
sibling_census: handleWebmcpCall also serves frontend and desktop calls, which do not carry a page sender tab; their existing context behavior was preserved. The WebMCP listener is the only page-message entry point. Existing tab-aware handlers already refuse a closed assigned tab.
repair: The page listener validates its allowed origin and sender tab, checks that the tab exists, and passes sender.tab.id into external dispatch.
External dispatch carries the optional assigned tab into ToolContext and returns an explicit origin-tab error if a page tab closes before dispatch.
Feature-test steps use document.modelContext.getTools and executeTool with a discovered RegisteredTool. External action calls require confirmation in both Ask and Act modes.
